name: Leo Tennis Academy
tagline: Serve with Power, Rally with Precision
description: Leo Tennis Academy in Andheri West delivers quality coaching for all ages. With well-maintained hard courts, evening floodlights, and a focus on fundamentals to competitive play, it’s a favored spot for tennis enthusiasts in Western Mumbai.

contact.address: No. 39, Manish Nagar Rd, opposite building, Gharkul Society, Indira Nagar, Four Bungalows, Andheri West, Mumbai 400053

highlights: Five well-maintained hard courts with consistent bounce
Floodlights for evening and late-night play
Close proximity to DN Nagar Metro Station
Community feel with friendly coaching staff

courses.title: Junior Beginners (Ages 8–12)
courses.description: Basic strokes, grip, footwork, and coordination drills.
courses.schedule: Mon, Wed, Fri – 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM

courses.title: Youth Intermediate
courses.description: Advanced shot selection, match scenarios, and court tactics.
courses.schedule: Tue, Thu, Sat – 6:00 PM to 7:30 PM

instructors.name: Coach Rohan Mehta
instructors.bio: Coach Rohan has trained several young players who have advanced to city-level tournaments.

instructors.name: Anjali Rao
instructors.bio: Anjali specializes in technique refinement and match strategy for older teens and adults.

facilities.name: Hard Tennis Courts
facilities.description: Five hard surface courts with excellent lighting and consistent bounce.

facilities.name: Floodlight System
facilities.description: Bright lighting for safe evening play.

facilities.name: Accessible Entrances
facilities.description: Wheelchair accessible entry and exit points.

facilities.name: Changing Rooms & Water
facilities.description: Basic changing and refreshment facilities on-site.

achievements: Longest-standing tennis facility in Manish Nagar since 2000
Consistently rated 4+ by users for court quality and ambience
